chat-template-thinking-toggle.label: Chat template — enable_thinking
chat-template-thinking-toggle.description: Adds enable_thinking to chat_template_kwargs. Default is ON.

enable_thinking.label: Thinking
enable_thinking.description: Explicitly enable or disable thinking for models whose chat template exposes enable_thinking.

chat-template-thinking-plus-clear.label: Chat template — enable_thinking + clear_thinking
chat-template-thinking-plus-clear.description: Two boolean controls forwarded through chat_template_kwargs: enable_thinking and clear_thinking.

clear_thinking.label: Clear preserved thinking
clear_thinking.description: Controls whether preserved thinking is cleared where the model/deployment supports that feature.

reasoning-effort-select.label: Reasoning effort (options set per model)
reasoning-effort-select.description: Top-level reasoning_effort. Different models accept different value sets (low/high/max, none/high/max, low/medium/high/xhigh, etc.) — the schema just fixes the wire shape (a single top-level 'reasoning_effort' string); the actual allowed values are curated per model in the Admin panel, not baked in here.

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: Pick a value from this model's option list, or choose Custom to type a value that isn't listed yet. Nothing is sent for this field until a value is actually picked or typed.

raw-chat-template-kwargs.label: Raw — chat_template_kwargs
raw-chat-template-kwargs.description: Escape hatch for a model/template whose chat-template parameters are not yet worth turning into structured controls.

__raw.label: chat_template_kwargs JSON
__raw.description: Enter the object that should be sent as chat_template_kwargs.

raw-top-level.label: Raw — top-level request fields
raw-top-level.description: Escape hatch for provider/model parameters that belong directly in the request body.

__raw.label: Top-level JSON
__raw.description: Enter request fields that should be merged into the chat-completions body.
